Lesson 6-3

Area: Standard Units

Warm-Up: Count the Unit Squares!

Topic 6 · Connect Area to Multiplication and Addition

What is the area?
I can …
measure the area of a shape using standard units.

Remember from Lesson 6-2

Unit squares can be different sizes. The size of the unit square changes the number we count.

Today: units that are the same size for everyone in the world! 🌍

Learn: How Can You Measure Area Using Standard Units?

Standard unit · Square unit · Count

New words
Standard unit
a unit that is the same size for everyone: inch, foot, centimeter, meter.
Square centimeter
a square with sides of 1 centimeter. We write it sq cm.
Square inch, foot, meter
squares with sides of 1 inch, 1 foot or 1 meter.
Standard units of length and area

Tap a unit to see its square unit.

Meg's sticker

Meg bought this sticker. Each unit square is 1 square centimeter. Tap the squares on the sticker to cover it. What is the area?

Square centimeters: 0

6 unit squares cover the sticker. The sticker is measured in square centimeters.
The area of the sticker is 6 square centimeters. 🎉

Solve & Share

Make a rectangle with an area of 8 square units. Tap the grid to color squares, then check. Can you find a different one?

Squares: 0

Convince Me! · Be Precise

If we use square inches instead of square centimeters, do we need more or fewer unit squares to cover the same shape?

Pick the unit squares.

A square inch is bigger than a square centimeter, so we need fewer square inches to cover the same shape.

Which unit fits?

Small things → small units. Big things → big units. Pick the better unit for each one.
